description: This is a PHP unit test class that verifies the uniqueness of route keys across plugin configuration files in a Human Resource Management system. It loads route configurations from YAML files for each plugin and checks for duplicate route keys, throwing an exception if duplicates are found.

classes.name: UniqueRouteKeyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that checks for duplicate route keys among plugin route YAML files in the system.

methods.name: testUniqueRouteKey
methods.description: Loads route configurations from plugin YAML files and verifies that all route keys are unique across plugins. Raises an exception if duplicate keys are detected.
